The '''Damask Holdings superspire''' was the headquarters of [[Damask Holdings/Legends|Damask Holdings]], the clandestine financial group founded by [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Hego Damask]], a [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] who was secretly the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Plagueis, and who used the group to advance his political influence in galactic politics with the ultimate goal of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Grand Plan/Legends|dominion]]. Located in the city of [[Harnaidan]] on the planet [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]], the skyscraper, one of Harnaidan's most magnificent, was acquired by Damask Holdings by [[115 BBY]], and housed the company's twice-weekly meetings in the two-hundredth floor boardroom for at least 50 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|standard]] [[Standard year/Legends|years]].

==Description==
Although smaller than the superspires used by the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]], the Damask superspire was constructed close to the largest geothermal lake in Harnaidan, which had been incorporated into the property as an exclusive spa. The boardroom used by [[Damask Holdings/Legends|Damask Holdings]] for its twice-weekly board meetings was located on a setback of the two-hundredth floor. From there, the chief officers and executives of Damask Holdings had a view of the lake and surrounding hot springs.<ref name="Darth P" />

==History==
By [[115 BBY]],<ref name="Founding" /> Damask Holdings acquired one of Harnaidan's most magnificent superspires. The building was used for the company's twice-weekly meetings over at least the next five decades.<ref name="Darth P" />

In [[67 BBY/Legends|67 BBY]], after that year's [[Gathering (Sojourn)|Gathering]], the issue of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]] reserves was discussed in a board meeting.<ref name="Darth P" />

[[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Hego Damask]] continued to run the company until [[52 BBY/Legends|52 BBY]], when all members except himself were killed in an [[Attack on the Lodge of the Canted Circle|attack]] at the [[Lodge of the Canted Circle|Lodge of the Order of the Canted Circle]] during [[Larsh Hill]]'s initiation ceremony. The group was not re-formed, and Damask withdrew from galactic affairs to devote his time to the [[Midi-chlorian manipulation|manipulation]] of [[Midi-chlorian/Legends|midi-chlorians]] in his [[Aborah]] laboratory, although Gatherings continued to be hosted until [[43 BBY/Legends|43 BBY]].<ref name="Darth P" />
